name: firm-client
description: Web Serial + Rust WASM client reading data packets from FIRM

scripts.build:wasm: cd firm_typescript && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name firm_client --no-default-features --features wasm && cd .. && rimraf firm_typescript/pkg/package.json firm_typescript/pkg/.gitignore
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
